description: Wire the live loop and retire the old real-time flows, strictly add-before-remove so the headless build never breaks. Add the ShootButton + 2D hand display + TurnController instantiation; own HoleContext in hex_grid (seed RNG, apply HoleDefinition, deal hand); route club-select/modifier/aim/preview/Shoot through TurnController; then retire the SpinMeter/SwingMeter confirm path, excise the real-time putting mini-game, confirm board-only wind, and finally delete the now-orphaned meter/putting/swing-hand scripts and scenes (Finding 7 two-retirement split, grep-guarded). Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (TurnController + harness must exist and pass BEFORE the deletions).
steps: R0: Add a clean Button "Shoot" (brass accent, bottom-center) to scenes/ui/main_ui.tscn and a simple HBoxContainer 2D hand strip (club row + modifier row); expose shoot_button in scripts/ui/main_ui.gd. In scripts/hex_grid.gd _init_card_system instantiate TurnController as a child of hex_grid, give it refs (shot_manager, card_system, aoe_system, wind_system, lie_system, hole_context, hex_grid), connect shot_manager.landing_resolved -> TurnController.apply_board_resolution, and wire ShootButton.pressed -> TurnController.execute_shot. Both legacy SpinMeter and the Shoot button can confirm at this point.

In scripts/hex_grid.gd hole setup: create a HoleContext, seed rng.seed from the definition seed (or random), set shot_manager.rng = hole_context.rng, and pass hole_context.rng to WindSystem.generate_wind. If definition.use_procedural is false build the grid from grid_width/height + apply surface_overrides/elevation_overrides + set tee/flag; else run existing generate_hole_with_par with the seeded RNG (additive; procedural path unchanged when definition==null; do NOT break procedural generation).

Add CardSystemManager.deal_hand_for_hole(hand_def, rng): source clubs from club_deck_manager / CardLibrary.get_club_deck() (NOT a nonexistent CardSystemManager.get_club_deck()); draw hand_size modifier cards from starter_deck.tres, or deal dealt_card_ids verbatim when fixed_hand. Clubs are a reusable bag (not consumed per shot); modifier cards deplete on play.

Route the loop through TurnController: club-selection path and CardSystemManager.activate_card_modifier call TurnController.rebuild() on every plan change; map 6-direction aim (keyboard/edge-click) to TurnController.set_aim_dir (existing hover/lock tile may remain as snap-to-nearest convenience). After rebuild(), hex_grid.refresh_aoe_display() renders the footprint (brightness proportional to aoe_weights, marker on center). Enforce ShootButton legality: disabled until a legal club for the current lie is played and an aim is set; Putter only on GREEN (read ctx.get_metadata("allowed_clubs") + explicit Putter-on-GREEN guard).

R1: change ShotUI._on_spin_confirmed / _on_swing_completed_with_spin to no-op or delegate to TurnController.execute_shot; disconnect SpinMeter.spin_confirmed / SwingMeter.swing_completed from the confirm path; set SwingMeter/SpinMeter/SpinMeterPanel nodes visible=false in main_ui.tscn (scripts stay in tree for now). Confirm the loop runs end-to-end via Shoot only.

R2: in hex_grid._start_new_shot remove the should_putt = ball_surface == GREEN -> putting_system.enter_putting_mode() branch so GREEN is a normal lie (lie table restricts to PUTTER). Stop instantiating PuttingSystem in _init_putting_system; remove putting_system field reads on the shot path. Keep _trigger_hole_complete/hole_complete_triggered and the ball-on-flag check intact.
R3: verify the flight animation in hex_grid reads the resolved landing_tile (board offset), not live per-frame wind; remove any live wind application found; otherwise document as verify-only.

R4 (do this LAST, only after the FEAT-002 harness still passes): grep for all references to each retirement target, treating the 2D SwingHand (scenes/ui/swing_hand.tscn / scripts/cards/swing_hand.gd) and the SwingHand3D SubViewport chain (scripts/swing_hand_3d.gd at /root/GOLF/Control/MainUI/SwingHand/SubViewportContainer/SubViewport/SwingHand3D in _init_card_system) as TWO SEPARATE retirements (Finding 7). Then, recompiling after each sub-step: (a) remove node instances SwingMeter/SpinMeterPanel/SpinMeter/SwingHand from main_ui.tscn and the SwingHand3D wiring in _init_card_system; (b) delete scene files scenes/ui/SwingMeter.tscn, scenes/ui/spin_meter.tscn; (c) delete scripts scripts/swing_meter.gd(+.uid), scripts/spin_meter.gd(+.uid), scripts/putting_system.gd(+.uid), scripts/swing_hand_3d.gd(+.uid), and swing-card-slot helpers scripts/cards/swing_hand.gd, scripts/cards/swing_card_3d.gd, scripts/cards/swing_slot_drag_strategy.gd, scripts/cards/modifier_card_3d.gd ONLY if grep confirms orphaned (keep any still referenced); (d) remove dangling refs in shot_ui.gd (swing_meter/spin_meter/_setup_*/_on_swing_completed*/_on_spin_confirmed) and card_system_manager.gd (swing_hand/swing_hand_3d/_setup_swing_hand/_on_swing_slot_*).
acceptance_criteria: AC1: scenes/GOLF.tscn loads headless with 0 script errors and generates a hole with a reachable flag_position.
AC2: at the tee a hand is dealt (>=1 playable club card; hand_size non-club cards).
AC9: landing on the Flag hex triggers the hole-complete state exactly once (_trigger_hole_complete guarded by hole_complete_triggered).
AC10: Putter rejected off-GREEN; GREEN ball resolves a putt through the play-card-then-Shoot path (no real-time mini-game).
AC11: water landing repositions + penalty and the loop continues (no fail state).
The FEAT-002 harness still passes end-to-end after every R4 sub-step.
After R4, grep shows no remaining references to deleted scripts/scenes; both clean-build commands report 0 new script errors.
verification: Run the two clean-build commands after EACH retirement sub-step -> 0 new errors.
Grep (ripgrep) for each deleted script/scene basename across scripts/ and scenes/ -> no remaining references.
Commit the changed/deleted source files on feature/gameloop-v1 (stage specific files; do not git add -A).
findings:
FEAT-003 complete. Live loop wired add-before-remove; all retirements done AFTER confirming the FEAT-002 harness still passed (40/40) both before and after each R4 sub-step.

LIVE WIRING (R0-R3):
- main_ui.tscn (uid://cdby66rujphi3): added %ShootButton (brass StyleBoxFlat accent, bottom-center, disabled by default) and %HandStrip PanelContainer with Rows>%ClubRow + %ModifierRow HBoxContainers (the 2D hand strip). scripts/ui/main_ui.gd exposes shoot_button, hand_strip, hand_club_row, hand_modifier_row via %-unique-name get_node_or_null.
- hex_grid.gd NEW FIELDS: turn_controller:TurnController, hole_context:HoleContext, shoot_button:Button, current_aim_dir:int=3 (3=Down=toward flag in this course layout; matches FEAT-002 geometry note).
- hex_grid._init_card_system now instantiates TurnController as a child, assigns shot_manager/card_system/aoe_system/wind_system/lie_system/hole_context/hex_grid refs, and connects shot_manager.landing_resolved -> turn_controller.apply_board_resolution (R#2 board walk). ShootButton.pressed -> hex_grid._on_shoot_pressed -> turn_controller.execute_shot (wired in _find_and_setup_ui MainUI branch).
- hex_grid._setup_hole_context() (called FIRST in _ready): creates HoleContext, rng=RandomNumberGenerator.new(), seed from definition.seed when a HoleDefinition exists else randi() (procedural path unchanged when definition==null), sets shot_manager.rng=hole_context.rng. Wind seeded: _log_hole_info now calls wind_system.generate_wind(difficulty, hole_context.rng).
- hex_grid._apply_hole_definition_overrides() (called after _generate_grid): when a non-procedural HoleDefinition is present, builds grid from grid_width/height + surface/elevation overrides + tee/flag. No-op when definition==null OR use_procedural (procedural generation untouched; no HoleDefinition is wired into the live GOLF.tscn yet, so this is a dormant seam).
- TURN PLAN ROUTING: hex_grid.rebuild_turn_plan() sets turn_controller.ball_tile (world_to_grid) + played_club=current_club + aim_dir, calls turn_controller.set_aim_dir(current_aim_dir) (which rebuild()s the footprint), then refresh_aoe_display() + _update_shoot_button_state(). Called on every plan change: set_club_by_name() (club change) and CardSystemManager._refresh_aoe_display() (modifier change) both trigger it. hex_grid.set_turn_aim_dir(dir) maps a 6-dir input to the controller. Legacy hover/lock aim remains as snap-to-nearest convenience (unchanged).
- SHOOT LEGALITY: hex_grid._is_shoot_legal() requires current_club>=0 + a legal club for the lie (via lie_system.calculate_lie allowed_clubs, ClubType ints) + Putter-only-on-GREEN AND GREEN-requires-Putter guards. _update_shoot_button_state() enables/disables shoot_button accordingly; it starts disabled in the scene.
- CardSystemManager.deal_hand_for_hole(hand_def, rng): clubs are a REUSABLE bag sourced from CardLibrary.get_club_deck() into club_deck_manager (NOT consumed per shot); modifier cards sourced from starter_deck.tres into deck_manager and DEPLETE on play; fixed_hand deals dealt_card_ids verbatim; non-fixed does a deterministic seeded Fisher-Yates (_seeded_shuffle) then trims to hand_size. NOTE: this is available for curated-hand wiring but is not yet called from the live hole-setup path (the existing initialize_starter_deck still seeds the live decks); FEAT-004 can call deal_hand_for_hole from hole setup when HoleDefinition/HandDefinition resources are authored.
- R3 (verify-only): the hex_grid flight animation (_on_shot_completed / _animate_ball_flight_with_bounce) reads the board-RESOLVED context.landing_tile (mutated in place by TurnController.apply_board_resolution) and derives the visual curve arc from the resolved end_pos vs an uncurved target. NO live per-frame wind is applied during flight. No code change needed.

R1 (meter confirm retired): ShotUI._on_spin_confirmed / _on_swing_completed* no longer confirm; the spin/swing meters are not connected to the shot path and are hidden. Confirmation is the turn-based Shoot button only.

R2 (putting mini-game excised): hex_grid._start_new_shot no longer branches to putting_system.enter_putting_mode() on GREEN; GREEN is a normal lie (lie table restricts to PUTTER). _init_putting_system() is a no-op (putting_system stays null); all remaining putting_system reads are guarded `if putting_system` null-safe (hole_viewer.gd keeps a duck-typed Node field). _trigger_hole_complete / hole_complete_triggered and the ball-on-flag check are intact (AC9).

R4 RETIREMENTS (grep-guarded, two SEPARATE swing-hand retirements per Finding 7, recompiled after each):
- (a) Removed node instances SwingMeter/SpinMeterPanel/SpinMeter/SwingHand from main_ui.tscn (load_steps 21->18) + removed the SwingHand3D SubViewport wiring from _init_card_system. Also removed the orphaned SpinMeterPreview node + ext_resource from shot_ui.tscn (load_steps 17->16).
- (b) Deleted scenes/ui/SwingMeter.tscn, scenes/ui/spin_meter.tscn.
- (c) Deleted scripts: swing_meter.gd(+uid), spin_meter.gd(+uid), putting_system.gd(+uid). SWINGHAND3D CHAIN (Retirement A): scripts/swing_hand_3d.gd(+uid), scenes/swing_hand_3d.tscn, scripts/cards/swing_card_3d.gd(+uid), scenes/cards/swing_card_3d.tscn, scripts/cards/swing_slot_drag_strategy.gd(+uid). 2D SWINGHAND (Retirement B): scripts/ui/swing_hand.gd(+uid), scenes/ui/swing_hand.tscn. NOTE: the FEAT spec said the 2D SwingHand script lived at scripts/cards/swing_hand.gd, but it actually lives at scripts/ui/swing_hand.gd (class SwingHand); scripts/cards/swing_hand.gd never existed.
- KEPT (still referenced, NOT orphaned): scripts/cards/modifier_card_3d.gd + scenes/cards/modifier_card_3d.tscn (used by scripts/cards/modifier_deck_3d.gd, which is NOT a retirement target). scripts/ui/shot_panel.gd + scenes/ui/shot_panel.tscn were left untouched (out of scope, already orphaned, and only contain unrelated 'SpinMeterContainer'/comment substrings, not real deps on the retired scenes).
- (d) Dangling refs removed: shot_ui.gd (SwingMeterScene preload, spin_meter/swing_meter fields, _setup_spin_meter/_setup_swing_meter, _on_spin_confirmed, _on_swing_completed*, _on_swing_cancelled, _try_record_debug_delta; _update_swing_button_state is now a no-op); hex_grid.gd (shot_ui.swing_meter.hide_meter() call removed); card_system_manager.gd (swing_hand/swing_hand_3d fields, _setup_swing_hand, _on_swing_hand_*, _on_swing_slot_card_dropped, _clear_selected_swing_card, set_swing_hand_3d, and the swing-slot lock/clear blocks in _on_shot_started/_on_shot_completed/reset_swing_deck_for_new_hole).
